grounding.states: Honda Odyssey is the other strong pick, 9.3/10 at U.S. News, drives most like a car, front-wheel drive only
grounding.from: U.S. News names the 2026 Honda Odyssey the best minivan, with an overall score of 9.3/10; It drives the most like a car, with responsive steering and a smooth V6; It is front-wheel drive only

value.answer: The Toyota Sienna, for me. Edmunds has it at #1, Quartz and AutoGuide pick it too, it's hybrid only with 35–36 mpg combined, and all-wheel drive is available. The Honda Odyssey is the one to get if you want it to drive like a car. U.S. News rates it 9.3/10, but it's front-wheel drive only.
